title: Great small non-stick pan for muffins or candies
text: Great small non-stick pan for muffins or candies. They call this a mini-muffin pan, but I think it is better for making candies (too small for muffins I like to make). Anyway, well made, beautiful color, easy to clean, this is a great cooking pan for any chef to have in their kitchen. A few of these in different sizes would make a great bridal shower gift to give to someone as unique gifts. Really loved this!
